description: The file 'object-file-convert.h' declares functions and structures for converting object files within a repository from one hash algorithm to another. It provides function prototypes for conversion, referencing repository, object ID, hash algorithm, and buffer structures, indicating its role in object file manipulation.

methods.name: repo_oid_to_algop
methods.description: Converts an object ID in a repository to a different hash algorithm.

methods.name: convert_object_file
methods.description: Converts an object file from one hash algorithm to another.
